==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{Henry}} [[nickname]]s his {{p|Sirfetch'd}} [[Lancelot]] and his {{p|Grookey}} [[Twiggy]].
* [[Marvin]] nicknames his {{p|Sobble}} [[Sniffler]].
* Henry and {{Casey}} receive [[Dynamax Band]]s. 
* Henry and Casey enter a [[Max Raid Battle]] against a {{p|Gurdurr}}.
* Henry catches the Gurdurr and names it Steeler.
